authoritative_source.goal_5_action: Obtain a separately authorized edition-identical source, or have the user provide one and explicitly confirm authorization for this agent-assisted complete-book comparison and repository output, before any transcription change.

live_workspace_audit.finding: No independent complete book source is present outside the immutable OCR tree and its generated projection.
live_workspace_audit.intentionally_deleted_material: Excluded from inspection, restoration, hashing, and use.

official_online_audit.book_identity: The official copyright page identifies First edition, Fourth printing, copyright 2002; the official book page identifies ISBN 1-57955-008-8.
official_online_audit.content_surface: The official table of contents exposes Preface, Chapters 1-12, Notes, Index, copyright page, and Colophon. Fixed-layout PDF/page-image evidence is advertised for main text and Notes, but the current Index interface exposes semantic HTML rather than a verified printed-layout Index source.
official_online_audit.edition_exactness_warning: The official online-version note says the semantic Index adds death dates learned after the printed book was finished in January 2002, so semantic HTML is not edition-static and cannot decide printed Index text.
official_online_audit.reason: The Wolfram Science site terms prohibit mirroring, bulk reproduction, and archiving without advance written permission. The current general Wolfram Terms also prohibit scraping or bulk downloading and use with AI-powered tools without a separate licensing agreement. The book copyright page permits only limited plain-text quotation and requires prior written consent for broader copying and illustrations.

legacy_tree.snapshot_algorithm: SHA-256 of the sorted sha256sum output for every regular file path
legacy_tree.snapshot_command: find ref/A-New-Kind-of-Science -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum
